mediator_designs.rationale: Ensures safe trade when both delegate, and prevents exploitation when only one delegates by canceling.
Protects both parties when mutually delegated, prevents exploitation when only one delegates.

When both parties delegate, fair execution ensures the trade completes as agreed, providing security. When only I delegate, cancellation protects me from being exploited by a non-delegating counterparty who could defect. This design minimizes my risk while allowing secure trades when mutual delegation occurs.
This design ensures safe trade when both parties delegate (execute_fair), and protects me from being cheated if I delegate alone (cancel). It encourages mutual delegation for guaranteed exchange.

As a self-interested agent, I want secure trades when both delegate (execute_fair ensures the agreed exchange), and protection when only I delegate (cancel prevents me from being exploited if the other defects). This minimizes my risk while allowing cooperative gains.
This design protects me when I delegate: if both parties delegate, trade executes fairly; if only I delegate, trade cancels so I don't get exploited by a defecting counterparty.

As a self-interested trader, I want secure trades when both parties delegate (execute_fair ensures the agreed exchange happens), but I want to avoid being locked into a trade where only I delegate and the other can defect (cancel protects me). This design maximizes my safety while allowing trusted mediated exchanges.

This design ensures safe exchange when both parties delegate (execute_fair), but protects a delegating party from being exploited when the other does not delegate (cancel). As a self-interested agent, I want to minimize risk while allowing cooperative trades when mutual trust is established via mediator.
Protects me when only I delegate (cancel prevents exploitation), ensures fair execution when both delegate, encouraging mutual delegation for secure trades.

This design ensures security when both parties delegate (fair execution) and protects a delegating party from being exploited if the other does not delegate (trade cancels rather than risking defection).

As a self-interested trader, I want protection when both parties delegate (execute_fair ensures the trade happens as agreed), but I want to avoid being exploited when only I delegate (cancel prevents me from being forced to deliver while the other party can still defect). This design minimizes my risk while allowing secure trades when mutual trust is established through mediation.

This design ensures safety when both parties delegate (guaranteed fair exchange) and prevents me from being forced into a one-sided delegation where the other party could defect. As a self-interested agent, I want to minimize risk while allowing cooperative trades when mutual delegation occurs.

As a self-interested agent, I want guaranteed fair exchange when both parties delegate to avoid defection. If only I delegate, I want the trade canceled to prevent being forced to deliver while the other party can still defect. This minimizes my risk while allowing secure trades when mutual delegation occurs.
As a self-interested agent, I want safety when both delegate (fair execution) and protection when only I delegate (cancel to avoid being exploited if the other defects).
This design protects me when I delegate alone (cancel prevents exploitation) while ensuring fair execution when both parties delegate, creating predictable trade outcomes.
Execute fair when both delegate to guarantee safe exchange; cancel when only one delegates to avoid being exploited by a defecting partner.

This design ensures safe trades when both parties delegate (execute_fair), and protects a delegating party from being exploited by a non-delegating party (cancel). As a self-interested agent, I want to minimize risk when I choose to use the mediator.

This design ensures safe trades when both parties delegate (no defection possible), but protects a delegating party from being forced into a trade where the other party could defect by canceling if only one delegates. As a self-interested trader, I want to minimize my risk while keeping the option to defect if advantageous.
